desc.zh: 越意外的事，信息量越大；熵把一个随机源的整体不确定性压成一个数。它既是压缩的绝对极限，也是机器学习损失函数的老祖宗，还与热力学的熵同源同式。
desc.en: The more surprising an event, the more information it carries; entropy compresses a source's total uncertainty into a single number. It is the absolute limit of compression, the ancestor of ML loss functions, and kin to the entropy of thermodynamics.
